item.tib: bdud 'dul gsang ba drag chen gyi sbyin bsregs kyi las byang
item.coloph: ces pa'i tshul 'di ni slob dpon 'chi med gtsug phud dang dbyer med pad ma 'byung gnas/ de nyid thugs sprul rgyal po yi/ zhabs rdul spyi bor blangs pa'i bde chen bdag mkhas 'dod ra chod byed pa ma yin te/ dam pa rnams kyis yang yang bskul ba'i ngor/ dus mtha'i sems can las dbang zhan pa dang / zhabs rdul spyi bor blangs pa'i gang zag blo rmongs rnams kyi don ched du/ 'phags mchog rnams kyi mdzad byang 'thor bu las/ gzhung gi sbyin sreg gsal bkod do/ 'on kyang me ri gyad phur rgyud las kyang / gshen gyi me la mchod pa 'di 'bul ba'i/ ye shes me dpung 'bar ba'i byin rlabs kyis/ bsod nams dpag tu med pa'i longs spyod 'grub/ ces so//
